claim_label: Impact of AI writing automation on critical thinking skills
description: This disagreement centers on whether automating writing tasks allows students to focus on higher-level problem-solving or if it fundamentally undermines cognitive development. One side argues it frees mental capacity, while the other insists the act of writing is essential for building critical thinking skills.

instances.assertion: Automating basic writing allows students to focus on higher-level problem-solving and managing AI outputs.
Writing is the actual process of thinking; skipping it prevents the brain from building necessary neural pathways.
